dedupe_keys.name: g pst inertia monitoring framework real time power system inertia estimation go package

description: The G-PST Inertia Monitoring Framework (inertia) is a Go package for real-time estimation of a power system's inertia, listed on the G-PST Open Tools Portal with NREL (now the National Laboratory of the Rockies) as developer. The README says it defines software interfaces for ingesting and reporting data in real time: unit commitment (H-constant) based estimation logic and data interfaces sit in its uc package, and PMU-based methods are planned. System integrators write deployment-specific ingestion code, for example for an energy management system or historian, that conforms to the data interfaces; results are then reported through the DataSink framework, which ships text and web visualisation sinks and accepts custom sinks, several at once. Coverage: any power system whose unit commitment data can be fed in. Format and access: Go source on GitHub (G-PST/inertia) with package documentation on GitHub Pages and a test workflow. Licence: BSD 3-Clause (portal); a LICENSE file is present in the repository. Caveats: only the unit commitment method is implemented; activity dates were not read. Simulation uses: monitoring falling system inertia as synchronous generation is replaced by inverter-based resources, as an input to frequency stability and operational resilience studies. Related records: PRAS (model-pras), also listed on the portal, assesses resource adequacy.
